metric: GLL weighted L2 of Vx/Vy minus expanded reference, physical top x=0..1400; common sample dt omitted
profile: L labels: dmax*L constant; F labels p5: fixed dmax173.0886108476381; quadratic, ABC at three outer edges; no mass damping
growth_diagnostic: strong_growth means late full-domain peak exceeds 10 times the full-time reference peak; includes PML and is a conservative gross-growth indicator, not a proof of long-time stability
reference: reused 6400x3200 homogeneous domain, same local h/p/dt
timing_note: single runs including full-domain output; output size decreases with thickness; historical L175 and old timings reused, not statistical kernel benchmarks
